title: every command and reference hands scripts no manifest placeholder
description:
The orchestrator-driven commands and reference documents still hand the model a <manifestPath> placeholder to fill in, and three of them hand it to a script that now resolves the manifest itself. Remaining sites, as recorded when the first-contact commands were fixed:
- commands/phase.md:110 (audit-status.py)
- commands/task.md:171 (audit-status.py)
- reference/orchestrator.md:92, 102 and 723 (audit-status.py)
- commands/status.md:346 (verify-invariants.py, which does not resolve)

The rule is also copied in two places: plugins/audit/scripts/manifest/audit-task.py:96-97 and :1479, and plugins/audit/scripts/panel/_panel_paths.py:139. Default-path constants exist in _journal_io.py:337, hooks/_config.py:153, _doctor_setup.py:773 and _doctor_trail.py:944.

Route every script a command or reference document hands a manifest through _manifest_io.resolve_manifest, drop the placeholders, and fold the copies of the rule into the one resolver where the layer rule allows. The acceptance includes one of two things: either manifest_placeholder_drift scans reference/ as well as commands/, or explicit pending rows cover orchestrator.md. MANIFEST_PLACEHOLDER_PENDING empties as each command is repaired.
desiredOutcome: no command or reference document asks the model to fill in a manifest path a script can resolve, and the rule for where the manifest is lives in one resolver
